Use an Xbox controller as a mouse and keyboard on Windows. Browse, watch videos, control media and type from the couch.

![Sidestick](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a7med3othman/sidestick/main/docs/main.png)

## Get started

1. Download **`Sidestick-windows.zip`** from **Assets** below.
2. Right-click the downloaded file and choose **Extract All…**, then **Extract**.
3. Open the extracted folder and double-click **`Sidestick.exe`**.

> **"Windows protected your PC"?** Sidestick isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about it. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Plug in your controller (USB or Bluetooth), before or after starting. Press **RS** (right-stick click) at any time to see every button binding on screen.

Windows 10/11 · No install or Python needed · [Full guide and bindings](https://github.com/a7med3othman/sidestick#readme)
